treddle.definition:
n. See Treadle.
n. A prostitute; a strumpet.
n. The dung of sheep or hares.

tredecillion.translation:
n. (pl.tredecillion, tredecillions)(在美、法)1后加42个0之数, (在英、德)1后加78个0之数
a. 上述数字的

tredennick.translation: [人名] [康沃尔人姓氏] 特里德尼克住所名称，来源于康沃尔语，含义是“宅地，居留地+设防的”(homestead,settlement+fortified)
